english_source_note: Equivalent Conditions for Convergence in Measure
callout_id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#5
english_title: Convergence in Probability Is Preserved Under Continuous Mappings
statement_en: Assume $f:\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is continuous. Then $$X_n \xrightarrow{\mathrm{P}} X \implies f(X_n) \xrightarrow{\mathrm{P}} f(X).$$
key_techniques: control of inverse images under continuity
callout_body:
假设$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$是一个连续映射，那么
$$X_n(\omega)\xrightarrow {\text{P}}X(\omega) \implies f(X_n) \xrightarrow {P}{f(X)}$$
